en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Craftsman‑style mansion or institutional building set far back behind an expansive manicured lawn. The scene is framed by mature trees and a palm in the foreground, with a concrete sidewalk running across the bottom of the image. The building has multiple gabled dormers, wide eaves, and many windows, giving it an early 20th‑century American residential or hotel appearance. Along the bottom edge there is faint, reversed handwriting or numbering.
